notes.title: FAQ I Horse breeding and available interactions
notes.content:
[h3] Hey Horse Lovers! 🐎💖

We know you have a ton of questions about breeding horses in My Horse: Bonded Spirits, especially when it comes to interacting with other horses in the stable. We've gathered some of the most frequently asked questions from our community and provided answers to help you on your equestrian journey. Feel free to check them out below! [/h3]



[b] Q: Is there breeding and raising horses in the game? [/b]
A: Yes, but not in a direct form. In the Stable Management tab, you have the option to pair a selected horse from your stable with a horse from another stable. To perform this action, you must have a free box in your stable 👆. As a result, you will receive a new, already adult horse with an additional trait, "Born in Stable," which allows you to build stats faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/4956c207893d1aa07aa8abf7bb74b5dec20d20d3.png[/img]

---

[b] Q: Can the player interact with other horses in the stable, besides their own? [/b]
A: The player cannot interact with other horses; they are petted, fed, and watered by the stable staff. After completing the main storyline and unlocking level 10 bonding, the player can continue the adventure with a new horse, forming a completely new bond with it. This time it will be faster thanks to the already developed character skills.

---

[b] Q: How else can you acquire horses besides pairing them? [/b]
A: Every week, there is an event in the game - a marketplace where the player can buy and sell horses.

---

[b] Q: Can the player send "bred" and bought horses to competitions and earn money from them? [/b]
A: Horses are a representative part of the stable. They help build its reputation, among other things. They participate in competitions and other events. We can also make them available for riding to guests or train them for work in hippotherapy.
All these events happen out of sight of the player, and management of such events in possible trough the stud management UI.





We hope these answers help you bond even more with your beloved horses! Remember, every horse is unique, and building a strong connection takes time and patience 💝

We invite you to seed your questions in the comments below 👇 If there is a need, we will do further editions of the FAQ, on other issues in our game 📝


See you soon,
My Horse : Bonded Spirits Team

notes.title: Changes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Horse Enjoyers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome to the first devlog since the release of 🐴My Horse: Bonded Spirits Prologue. We’ve received a lot of your feedback and based on the pointers, suggestions and reports you’ve submitted we’ve been working on introducing lots of changes to the game. This has been our priority and the entire team’s focus. That’s why today’s devlog will be different from the previous ones as we’ll discuss the course of changes in the game instead of the usual presentation of new content. 📝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/ffe2f9bb125c6ad0c894681e9ac90010d14dcc5d.jpg[/img]
First and foremost we’ll [b]change the horse movement system[/b]. You’ve made your opinions clear on this one and now you’ll be able to [b]control your horse using only your mouse[/b]. 🏇 Keep in mind that to do this, we have to rebuild the entire control system and it takes a while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/f1fa3a08215665bf136a13c4e35d09962b5d1ec2.jpg[/img]
Secondly, [b]we’ve introduced voice acting narration instead of the previous AI voice over[/b] which was another thing you’ve been frequently asking for. 🎤	

You've also mentioned Robbie. We’ve altered her dialogs so now she’ll be more natural and less overwhelming.

Another frequently mentioned topic was the [b]problem with realism[/b]- why would we make a newbie raider pair with an untamed horse. Rest assured, [b]although it’s true that the main character is new to horse riding, her horse partner is an experienced horse[/b], all it takes is for your character to gain skills and build mutual understanding with the horse. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/e1b069db6d96aa4296119c96339650bf850b7996.jpg[/img]
[b]We’re also working on fixing all the reported bugs and optimizing the challenges[/b] as some of them were too easy- making them not interesting, or too hard which was also a drawback for some of the players. 

These were the topics appearing most frequently but it doesn’t mean we’re ignoring the less popular ones! That’s why if you have a suggestion or an idea what change or feature we should introduce to the game make sure to leave a comment in the discussion section or on our discord and have an actual impact on the game! 👍

Thank you for reading the entire devlog. We’re looking forward to hearing your responses.

[h1][b]Hello Horse Enjoyers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]We’re happy to meet you yet again in another devlog from our stud farm! 🤩[/b][/h3]

Today’s a special day. We’d like to take a break from the mechanics, challenges and all the high paced action. We’d like to slow down and take you for some sightseeing. Pack your things and get ready- today’s destination is the [b]CITY[/b]! 🌇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/42ba2e25dac7eee3532606a103c1d6a0eb788a17.jpg[/img]
[h3]The world of My Horse: Bonded Spirits is not just the forests and your farm, completely cut off from reality. There is also the city which we’ve already mentioned on different occasions where many unique and charismatic NPCs live. 🏠[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/2c03bd8f2ed047e020c6ed081fef5ac122816161.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/b49e0c87d3c31ec7314970f73f32a155c4804aed.jpg[/img]
As you can see, it’s a beautiful and peaceful village with clearly noticeable rustical elements. The place is very tidy and the lanterns placed alongside the roads will help you find your way when the sun goes down. 🕯️ 

Not to mention, they’re definitely adding to the unique charm of the entire place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/e27a1c33301ba0ce09358cd5dcb0a8c54a9cebd5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/c81c35f8914b19738231ff021c92c317bfcd9868.jpg[/img]
Placed in such a picturesque landscape it is definitely a location which you’ll visit not only during your quests but also to spend some time exploring and sightseeing. 🙂 And who knows what mysteries and secrets remain hidden on your way? 

We suggest taking your time and exploring the entire area thoroughly because you never know what treasures may you find. 🗺️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/b60ce79ba27bfa16a4dd335e2e244f476d1135d2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/3134abac75e9f77a25c3d96f2590079eee8c4bc9.jpg[/img]
[b]This place is still under development but we can’t wait to hear your opinions! Do you like the style of the buildings, would you like us to add some special activities/facilities to the area? Let us know on our discord 👇 or in the comments below! If you enjoy our devlogs and would like to support the game, we’d like to invite you to add this game to your Wishlists on Steam so you get notified about everything we post! 💪[/b]

notes.title: Challenges
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re very excited to welcome you to the new devlog from My Horse: Bonded Spirits! 🐴 Today, we’d like to showcase a new, exciting feature that will undoubtedly make the gameplay more interesting. We’d like to present to you [b]the challenges[/b].

During your gameplay you’ll be able to face different challenges some of which will be available to you at the paddock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/55da132b57a807a94fe7b2411eb0ea26e43ed4fa.png[/img]
One of the challenge variations available in the game is the [b]barrel racing[/b]- which is a track filled with barrels that you have to pass in correct order. The most important factors affecting the final score are the time and amount of mistakes you make throughout the entire race. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/f843cdd1c2608b6c1a73f67e9bb608112ee9026c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/ba45378c8f6f6be24a24e4d911edf2a52b195ba3.png[/img]
[h3]On top of the challenges on the paddock, you’ll also find them outside in the field. But we’ll tell you more about it in the future devlogs 😜[/h3]

Each of the challenges you’ll find will have a few different difficulty levels to choose from. The difficulty level will impact the time limit needed to pass the challenge, amount of mistakes you’re allowed to make throughout the course or the overall difficulty of the course.

To be able to complete even the most demanding challenges you’ll have to train with your horse. Building a proper relationship with it, training, raiding and jumping together will surely make a huge difference. You’re not doing it just for the prestige of completing the challenge, after completing each difficulty level there will be a reward waiting for you which will be appropriate to the challenge it presents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/a7c2a8c9248600a5aa407fc1f086ec0be9c77e76.png[/img]
[b]We can’t wait to hear your ideas and opinions about this aspect of our game so make sure to let us know in the comments below or on our discord! 👇 If you enjoy our work and would like to support us, please consider adding the game to your wishlists on Steam! 💝[/b]

notes.title: Customization
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋 [/b][/h1]

With the help of recent devlogs and the demo version you’ve already met some of the townsfolk, saw the stud farm, the area around and so much more. 🙂 Therefore today, we’d like to focus on something else. It’s a topic you’ve been asking about a lot but we’ve only given you a positive answer, not any specifics. [b]Today we’ll talk about customization! 🤩[/b]

[h3]As we’ve already mentioned, there will be the possibility to customize your character, horse’s hair, but that’s not all. Throughout your adventure in My Horse, you’ll be able to change:

-horse’s hair color
-the shape of mane and tail
-your character’s hairstyle
-color of saddle and bridle 
-covers for horse’s eyes and muzzle
-your saddle
-clothing

notes.title: New Horse Jumping
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]The recent weeks were wild ones. We’d like to thank all of you who took part in the Playtests and the Steam Next Fest and even more, thank the people who gave us their feedback. 💝 This month’s devlog is possible thanks to you.[/h3]

With that being said some of you might have wondered what is the actual topic of the devlog. It’s the new horse jumping system… Improvement based on the feedback we’ve received throughout these events! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/041ba4bcd47843e9b0ca0f53a9597280eec08c73.png[/img]
If there was one aspect of the game continuously pointed out by the players, it was the horse jumps. From now on during the competitions, on the premises of your stud farm or while breaching the terrain obstacles[b] a new, special UI [/b]will appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/b59a4dfecb54146e19759a562521065fd76db01c.png[/img]
This UI will display when is the best moment to start the jump, the closer to the middle of the bar you press it, the better the jump will be. If you don’t manage to hit the area responsible for jumping, the horse will stop before the obstacle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/b74d22dbc61c66f4e862eb5feaf03c1b3e169be5.png[/img]
If you enjoyed the previous system- don’t worry! 👍 If there are no obstacles in the vicinity, the horse can jump the way it did before.

Once again, we’re very grateful for your involvement throughout the entire development process. We hope you’ll keep supporting us and letting us know your ideas and thoughts on the mechanics and other aspects of the game we’re showing you with each devlog! 🙂

If you enjoy the game thus far, [b]consider adding the game to your Steam Wishlists [/b]👇 as this helps us reach more and more people! We also encourage you to[b] join our discord [/b]👇 and meet other people from our community!

notes.title: Meet the NPCs!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Horse Lovers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to another devlog from My Horse: Bonded Spirits! 🐴 This time we’ve prepared a lot of information. Today, [b]we’d like you to meet all the amazing NPC’s you’ll become acquaintances with during your adventure in game.[/b] 🙂 Grab yourself a nice drink and let’s get into it!

Before we discuss others… let’s take a look at you- the main character, shall we? The players’ character is a young child of a millionaire who got “punished” for thoughtlessly spending lots of money. 💰 As you can guess, your father sent you to a remote, neglected stud farm to teach you a lesson of humility and responsibility. (One could assume you’ve been quite a spender as he’s sent you without any financial support 😂)

On that very stud, you meet your beloved steed and start learning how to take care of it as well as how to bring the entire facility back to its former glory. 💪

It’s precisely during this process when you’ll meet all the interesting people 👱 from the nearby town. [b]Some of them will immediately become your trusted allies and help you rebuild the farm, 🤝 some will try to make you fail and quit. [/b]😡 But there is one thing you should always focus on - you and your horse shouldn’t be separated! 🏇
 
With that being said, let’s take a closer look at theNPCs.


[h3][b]Father[/b][/h3]

Your father will appear mostly at the start of the game and at the progress points throughout the gameplay. He’ll never appear in person but he’ll always call when you achieve another step. ☎️ I wonder how does he know… 


[h3][b]Main Employee: Jackson[/b][/h3]

Jackson will help and train you in every aspect necessary to take good care of horses and stud farm. 🤠[b] He’ll lead you through the entire tutorial and give you most of the missions and tasks.[/b] At the beginning, he’ll dislike you, considering you as nothing more but a rich spoiled kid. 🙁 Do your best to change the way he sees you, how well you perform will make him change his mind about you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/13279a7546ebd7086bab6b51fee3399552b9c2b4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Aide: Robbie[/b][/h3]

A helping hand and player’s support. 😀 This kind soul will always treat you nicely and be positive about you. [b]Without any malice or reluctance they’ll explain even the most basic things connected to taking care of the horses![/b] 💝 Watch out, their smile is said to be contagious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/693a73088be0c7abea67885585b701a98d217382.png[/img]

[h3][b]Neighbour: Heather[/b][/h3]

[b]The main antagonist of the game.[/b] She does her best to make the stud farm fall or at least not prosper at all, because she doesn’t like horses. She claims they are smelly, loud and messy. 😡 [b]She’ll be very hostile toward you from the very beginning[/b], I wonder if you can somehow change her mind about your place. 🤔 Perhaps helping her with some tasks is a good start?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/45d1fe3ae0f99b5bcd8c0f3ffeb0b415207ec6c2.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Mayor: Isaac[/b][/h3]

[b]This elegant gentleman 🧐 is very determined to help the player succeed.[/b] You might wonder why… Actually it’s simple. A popular tourist attraction such as a stud farm is bound to help the town earn some money. 💲 You cannot exclude the option he does this because he wants to have a good relationship with your father.


[h3][b]The Hippie: Oscar[/b][/h3]

Long haired, always wearing sunglasses, [b]believes the horses are kept in the stud farm against their will and has an obsession about setting them free[/b]. Will you try to make him change his mind or are you going to antagonize him even further? The choice is yours! 👍


[h3][b]The Psychologist: Hana[/b][/h3]

Hana is a local psychologist whose patients are mostly kids. 📝 She believes riding horses would benefit her patients during their treatment and wants to cooperate with the stud farm. She is [b]very professional and serious about her work[/b], always putting it first. Rumors say she doesn’t really like Heather. This Korean doctor is always cheerful and neat. 


[h3][b]The Hermit: Eddie[/b][/h3]

In the last devlog you saw his place. ⛺ Now it’s time to meet its owner! This bearded, long haired man is really shy and fearful.[b] He doesn’t like spending his time around people and rarely speaks but he loves horses.[/b] The first time you’ll ever meet him, he’ll visit the grassland where horses enjoyed some fresh greens just to watch them and then run into the forest. A strange and lonely fellow but a harmless one. 🌳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/fbb4779c5ced2a59576e559a9933f1367b7c8a49.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]The Blacksmith: Julia[/b][/h3]

A muscular, tattooed middle aged lady. 💪 She took over the family business when she was a young girl and this year she passed the 20 years mark as a craftswoman. [b]Strong, independent and very skilled at her work.[/b] She creates not only horseshoes and nails but also jewelry 💍 which she promptly sells at her internet shop. She also has a successful social media profile, [b]she’s kind of an influencer. 🗨️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/9c50801bb1975ac1b43bb9347f8f30be3bc355ac.png[/img]

[h3][b]Vet: Sebastian[/b][/h3]

A young, charming gentleman of Mexican origins. [b]He doesn’t like to talk to people and rarely smiles 🤐 but he treats all animals like his children. His entire demeanor and voice changes as soon as he interacts with them. [/b]🐕 Some people suspect he might have a crush on Robbie. 🤭

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/ac64109c5db1eb922713d076adcf2c832e6d21e2.png[/img]

Those are all the NPCs we wanted you to meet today! What do you think about them? We can’t wait to hear your opinions in the comments! 😊

notes.title: Horse riding
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to our Stud Farm! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]It’s been a while since you’ve last heard of us but rest assured we’ve not been wasting our time! 👍 Let’s take a look at the star of not only this devlog but also the entire game- the horse! 🏇[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/3bb25201eed7c2170f942ad38e146e1985548343.png[/img]
[h3]Ever since your arrival at the Stud Farm, you’ll have to start [b]building trust and strengthening bonds with your horse[/b]. To achieve that, you can interact with your magnificent friend in various ways such as:[/h3]

[b]- combing their hair,
- petting,
- feeding.[/b]

Keep in mind these are only a few of the possibilities! As for the rest… Well, we’ll let you find out on your own! 😜

[h3]Before the first horse ride, players will have to complete a series of quests 📝 which will introduce them to the game rules, animal care, proper saddling and preparing your horse for a ride together.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/89782fe4a3f33e028120039fc221457653d4073e.png[/img]
Shortly after completing the first few tasks, you’ll start [b]raising your raiding skill level[/b] by venturing into the open areas around your stables. 🐴 Trotting is not the limit when it comes to what you can do together with your steed. 

Gallop, or even jumping over the obstacles are also possibilities but those are skills you’ll have to learn together![b] Learning comes naturally through practice and repetition of different activities[/b] such as riding, jumping etc. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/794680f262ca32e49061e1ad2f960b413c5f41c9.png[/img]
[h3]Remember that your horse, although strong and admirable, can also get tired. That’s why you have to[b] keep a close eye on its level of stamina, fullness and overall fatigue[/b]. 👀 Don’t neglect this aspect because this is the only way to [b]ensure your horse is healthy, full of energy and keen on exploring[/b] and learning new riding techniques![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/1b84fa99c3eacee943b1f7dfef6d988dcae21745.png[/img]
After achieving a certain level of your riding skills, you’ll be able to take tours on more demanding routes at the end of which skill points will await. Face the challenges as those points will undoubtedly help you develop your stud farm! 🤩

[h3]You can also earn experience points through completing quests available for players during map exploration! 🗺️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/c652be757ab51c24a0be6cead67c80fc22a464e1.png[/img]
We’ve also spotted a suspicious building nearby. Perhaps you’ve got any ideas who lives there? 🤔 Let us know in the comments! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/009bba1cf5962dc76823bc0f1589bd1f5a7c2273.png[/img]

and [b]join our discord community 👇[/b] to give our dev team your suggestions, ideas and feedback directly to them!

notes.title: Stables
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

The time has come for yet another update from our stud farm! 🤩 Today, we’d like to give all of you a tour around the stable and talk about our plans for this and all the other buildings! 

As we’ve previously mentioned, when you start playing the game you become the owner of a dilapidated stud farm and your task is to bring your place back to its former glory. The experience would be lacking without an ability to [b]restore the buildings, upgrade their looks and achieve a high-end stud farm with your efforts.[/b] Therefore, all of your buildings will start as old, neglected structures you’ll be able to upgrade! 👷

Let’s move on to the stable! 🔍 We’ve decided for three levels of this building. Now we’ll take a closer look at each of them!

[h3][b]Level 1:[/b][/h3]
The basic condition of the building you’ll encounter at the beginning of your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/e97d64a84ad58592c666f5d38d79483e6a24e7b0.png[/img]
As you can see it’s old and needs restoration. It’s been left unattended for a long time and every aspect of the building requires your attention. Not a look worthy of an award-winning stud farm, is it? 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/972006e07e3089bc446a1bb8203dd3ff97917301.png[/img]
Used up materials, a simple building structure, lack of any kind of decorations… But everyone has to start somewhere, so let’s not get too discouraged and move on to level 2! 🙂

[h3][b]Level 2:[/b][/h3]
After a while, with enough money and materials you’ll be able to perform the first renovation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/c641430d212a9142f7951b3d9a01b7439a0da758.png[/img]
Even though the simple shape of your stable remains, the exterior walls got painted,  roof truss was given the new materials. You can also notice, the main entrance was given simple wooden ornaments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/d0992097f9908e1b9ebbc729dee33d9e3c13a21a.png[/img]
The interior was given a paneling in 4 different possible colors. On this level the building looks tidy, well-kept but at the same time it’s simple and still has room for improvement. That’s why we present to you level 3! 🤩

[h3][b]Level 3:[/b][/h3]
The final version of the stables is different. The entire structure got altered, receiving a new, more complex shape. New extended roof and openable, two-part doors instead of windows provide you with a more organic experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/f34ece315f4a12dee3ac6d0cf50ed352b3a456f6.png[/img]
On top of that we’ve given you 4 coloristic variants of bricks to let you alter the looks of your stables even more! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/1cb3182da4f17fbf45f2a3a66d7ee0058ab581e9.png[/img]
As for the functions, the stable provides you with- a few horseboxes and a storage room where all the accessories necessary to take care of your horses are kept. 

Let us know if you like the looks of the stable! We can’t wait to hear your opinions so[b] join our discord community [/b]👇 and share them with us! Don’t forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist [/b]👇 to not miss on any further update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2376970/My_Horse_Bonded_Spirits/ 


See you soon,
My Horse Team
